visual_checklist.fonts: No visible missing glyphs or mixed CJK families; embedded TsangerJinKai02 confirmed.

limitations: Read-only review used the supplied final rendered evidence and existing visual-check log. The reviewer did not rerender or author PDF, HTML or CAD artifacts.

Visual and PDF/font/content observations were checked directly. Claims about saved BRep provenance, native TechDraw geometry and STEP equivalence rely on the supplied validation reports; no independent CAD reconstruction, dimensional measurement or Boolean audit was performed.
Official hardware specifications and photographic references were not independently researched in this review; this pass checks preservation of the stated source and approximation boundaries.
The page-image hashes and PDF hash bind this review to the inspected files. The reviewer did not independently establish render-byte equivalence between the supplied PNGs and PDF.
